title: THE MEDALS SOUND BY TIER
why: His order after the party playtest was medals polished the way Halo does them, and in Halo a rarer medal sounds bigger. Every style medal kept its own short note, one for each picture. Now the tier of the medal adds a voice on top of it: the plain medals (copper) add nothing and are just a tick, the skilled ones (amber) add a high two-note shimmer, and the rare ones (gold) add a low thump and a rising run of six bright notes, so a rare medal is heard across the room. Sound only: no score changes and nothing is drawn from the seeded stream.
now: Rarer medals sound bigger: a plain tick, a high shimmer, or a low thump and a rising run.
